text:
maria_sales: Quick ping 1 HelixMed wants a compliance bundle to finish their procurement review. They asked for: redacted SOC2 control matrix excerpt, ISO27001 scope statement or excerpt, a signed pentest attestation for our staging cluster addressed to their security team, and a delta estimate for delivering an on-prem VM image vs hosted POC. Can we turn this around by Thursday? @tom_se @leah_compliance @omar_security

tom_se: I can run the ops estimate. Note: on-prem VM adds a QA validation pass and licensing packaging. Ballpark today: $11k one-time packaging/validation, $1.9k/mo support. If they want us to coordinate pentest windows add $1k.

leah_compliance: For SOC2 we can provide the control matrix excerpt + scope page. We'll redact internal hostnames and timelines. ISO27001: we can supply the scope page or the certificate excerpt if available. Need 24-36 hours to redact and sign.

omar_security: Pen-test attestation: we can sign a letter confirming a third-party assessment of the isolated staging environment. We will not share vulnerability details. Legal prefers Director-level sign-off and a clause disallowing exploitation of customer data or product peering. If HelixMed wants to run their vendor, we require an NDA addendum + POA from Legal and a defined test window. That adds ~2 business days.

maria_sales: HelixMed asked whether the attestation must include IPs or CIDRs; their SOC engineer prefers CIDR.

omar_security: We prefer descriptive scope ("isolated staging cluster, CIDR range provided upon request") rather than publishing IPs in the letter. If they insist, Legal needs to review disclosure.

ticket-bot: Created ticket EVID-4110 for HelixMed compliance bundle. Checklist: SOC2 excerpt, ISO excerpt, pen-test attestation, NDA addendum, network isolation diagram. Owner: maria_sales.

maria_sales: Tom 1 can you paste a tiny ASCII network sketch for the bundle?

tom_se: Sure:

[Internet] -> Ingress LB -> Bastion Jumpbox -> Isolated Staging VPC (no prod peering)
Management subnet on separate VLAN, monitoring via read-only telemetry to S3.

maria_sales: Perfect. Leah 1 please drop redacted PDFs when ready and Omar please paste the draft attestation for quick Legal review. I'll feed HelixMed a non-binding estimate to keep procurement moving. Thanks all :thumbsup:
